assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's two curated REVIEWED items at basis_commit, both active_provisional and read in full with their front matter: the accepted-cohort monograph (SECONDARY_IRIS_EXPANDED_V1) and the bounded expanded reconstruction model with rules SI-D01 to SI-D07, support table, rivals and failure modes. Their evidence is bounded native backjoins to MAIN06 C2/C4/finale/Ep1/Ep2, MAIN10 C2/C5/Ep, MAIN11 C1, CONTEXP01/02, DUST03 and MASK C2, with zero new full-reading credit. The KonoSuba reader guide and corpus map was read for method, authority and scope only. The Iris evidence index, receiving record, forecast lineage annex, readings, ledgers and Japanese source are not curated on this subject and nothing rests on them. The project's own 'Tier3' labels are inputs, not conclusions. No primary source was inspected.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Episode slices kept separate: MAIN06 (court, games, body swap, farewell, private epilogue), MAIN10 (cooking, combat, diplomacy, gift), MAIN11 C1 (wish-duty scene), CONTEXP01/02, DUST03 (masked play, funding papers, temporary flight, later ring reference) and MASK chapter 2 (ruler outing before the Eris festival). Her stated age of 12 holds throughout. Publication order is not in-world date, and no default present state is fixed. Later letters and reports, the unread MAIN07-MAIN17 excluded components and any adult future are outside this assessment.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, including the owner calibration rulings; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The model gives competing goals (public protection, relationship continuity, being treated as a person, competent contribution, recognized achievement, interesting ordinary activity, control over restricted movement) with no exception-free top goal, and seven conditioned rules with contrary cases. They say what changes her response: a trusted counterpart offering safe ordinary participation (SI-D01; MAIN06 C2 P234-254/543-546, MAIN10 C2 P270-300), an explicitly recognized legitimate public obligation (SI-D02; MAIN11 C1 P328-361, DUST03 U014 P103-130), salient personal achievement before reunion (SI-D03; MASK U015 P137-170/210-223), credible actor-specific danger advice and a newly volunteering provider (SI-D05), relational meaning against a price-only account (SI-D06), and understood unwanted bodily use (SI-D07). It predicts her errors: uneven ordinary knowledge, imitation of a mentor's script, premature belief in an appealing role, status-based reassurance and motivated use of influence (SI-D04; CONTEXP02 U020 P475-499, U013 P83-148). Not A: none of the seven rules has future-source validation, SI-D04 and SI-D05 are LOW, no global goal hierarchy is learned, and unfamiliar-person choice is underdetermined. Not C: the account discriminates which condition changes the choice and states where it stops, so the remaining uncertainty is mostly about wording and intensity, not about which motive decides.

Episodes are kept apart with their own knowledge, equipment and relationships, and the monograph splits supplemental books by episode (MASK's outing before the Eris festival; DUST03's pre-resolution funding concern versus its later ring reference). It shows local changes: a current refusal of renewed engagement (MAIN10 C5 P754-758) that does not reconstruct earlier private views, and address changes treated as relationship events. Not C: no developmental state sequence, default state or located transition is modeled, and 'developmental change versus local relationship' is kept as an open rival (model section 12). Not E: the episode-by-episode separation spans MAIN06-MAIN11, CONTEXP01/02, DUST03 and MASK and is explicit.

Written 私, polite clause forms and royal vocabulary; argument, competitive insistence and direct correction in play; hesitant requests that become sustained bursts under attachment; older-brother address varying with closeness, with a later request for bare peer address not erasing an earlier rebuke. The model gives a function-first procedure (ask, challenge, correct, thank, refuse or pressure, then register for addressee and state) and the MAIN06 finale P143-194 shows rank-based self-assertion and a scuffle, not only polite speech. Not B: few exact forms are quoted, there is no addressee-by-addressee inventory, and the analysis concerns written pragmatic function only. Not D: register shifts are located and tied to relationships and acts.

Ordinary activity is central and located: school, festival and wage questions (MAIN06 C2 P98-118), the game sequence with protest, rematch and her own calculated distraction (P234-254, P285-307/319-335), the cooking help and her correction about a live ingredient (MAIN10 C2 P270-300), stalls during the body-swap outing as Megumin reports them, and the 400-Eris ring. SI-D01 is a conditional rule for first participation. Not B: the rule covers encounters with unfamiliar ordinary activity; daily court routine, recurring preferences and repeated ordinary contexts are not established. Not D: there is a located conditional rule with support from two main volumes.

Recipient-specific conduct is differentiated and conditioned: Kazuma (genuine play, stories, sibling-like attachment and sought recognition, alongside misinformation she does not check; his adult projections kept as his viewpoint), Megumin and Yunyun (peer desire, rivalry, real skill differences, information withheld, the friends' own boundaries), Claire and Rain (valued care and contested control; credible warnings, unwanted restraint, exploitable affection, Rain's pay penalty), Dust (a voluntarily accepted short flight distinct from earlier mask intrusion), Vanir (a finite hired role and his independent refusal of longer employment) and Levi (diplomacy and chosen friendship without renewed engagement, MAIN10 C5 P446-477/754-758). Not A: strangers are explicitly underdetermined and transfer to unsampled relations is not supported. Not C: the model states how each relation changes what she seeks and what errors are likely.

MAIN06 Ep1 supplies her own private appraisal: she understands her retainers' concern, plans intercession rather than a completed pardon, keeps a hope they misunderstand, and privately recalls the stolen ring's marriage symbolism. Her stated reasons are located in MASK U015 (wanting praise for an achievement of her own before reunion) and MAIN06 C2 P543-546 (what she likes about Kazuma). Most other access is through Kazuma, Megumin, Dust or Vanir. Not B: there is one private-focalization section, and the monograph keeps narrator inferences attributed. Not D: direct private appraisal and stated reasons exist and change the reading of her courteous surface.

Located conflict choices across episodes: protest and rematch after deception, then a calculated distraction of her own (MAIN06 C2 P299-305, P329); the farewell argument and scuffle with Megumin over address (finale P143-194); defense of Darkness's standing (MAIN10 C2 P232-249); court pressure through royal-protector rhetoric, sadness and threatened withdrawal of affection (CONTEXP02 U013 P83-148); obeying a danger warning, then ordering punishment when Vanir volunteers (MASK U015 P315-322, P375); explicit stop requests in the body swap (MAIN06 C4 P309-312/349). SI-D04, SI-D05 and SI-D07 condition these. Not A: SI-D04 and SI-D05 are LOW and CONTEXP01 U013 P186-192 is adverse to SI-D05. Not C: the evidence says which conditions recruit pressure, compliance or a boundary, and it predicts misuse of influence.

Located weighing with stated reasons: the MAIN11 wish-duty scene, where she rejects a substitute charm, names her duty to protect the people and reduces the request (C1 P328-361); the DUST03 refusal to abandon the kingdom and her check that a temporary flight will not cause trouble (U014 P103-130, P354-370); the reduced farewell request after Darkness explains Kazuma's obligations (MAIN06 C2 P399-421). SI-D02 is MODERATE. Not B: the ethics of influence (court coercion, the false-witness offer) rests on SI-D04 at LOW confidence, and the account cannot say when she will notice or disclose costs to others. Not D: explicit duty-versus-wish weighing is shown more than once with her own reasons.

Play is a major domain: wanting an opponent who tries, protest at unfair tactics, her own calculated distraction, competitive bursts, the farewell rivalry with Megumin. The model separates canonical comic magnitude from transfer mechanism and states that a competitive exercise does not establish fair-play ethics. Not B: her own humor production (jokes, teasing) is not analyzed, and the synthetic refusal of a ceremonial win is a plausible completion, not source. Not D: play behavior is located and tied to the SI-D01 participation rule.

The rechecked joins are enumerated with paragraph locators (MAIN06 C2/C4/finale/Ep1/Ep2, MAIN10 C2/C5/Ep, MAIN11 C1, CONTEXP01/02, DUST03 and MASK C2), with zero new full-reading credit. The monograph states that V07/V08 contain no new direct Iris interaction, that V09's letter is not a full test, that the broader census and the MAIN07-MAIN17 excluded components remain open, and that letters, legend, author commentary and reference profiles keep lower weights. Not B: the census is admittedly incomplete and the evidence index and receiving record are outside this set. Not D: coverage is bounded precisely and the gaps are named.

Affirmative adverse evidence is kept, not explained away: the CONTEXP01 U013 P186-192 warning-then-cast adjacency that lowers SI-D05 to LOW; the CONTEXP02 false-witness offer and court coercion against any honesty or compliance summary; the calculated distraction against a fair-play trait; stale political information in MASK; her limited knowledge of Kazuma's claims; recognizing one impostor without universal deception detection; royal position not editing a card record. Historical I01/I02 outcomes are recorded as untested where they were untested. Not A: several limits rest on one episode each. Not C: these are located counterinstances that change the model's rules, not gaps.

The model requires binding each slice's knowledge, permissions, skills, equipment, relationships and political situation; a later weapon or skill is unavailable earlier without its source join; MASK's outing precedes the Eris festival; DUST03 contains both a pre-resolution funding concern and a later gifted-ring reference; the three rings (MAIN06 Ep1 stolen ring, MAIN10 Ep P34-60 400-Eris gift, DUST03 treasury reward) are separate objects; age is fixed at her stated 12. Not A: there are no in-world dates for most episodes and no default present state. Not C: the episode-binding rules are explicit and operational.

conditions: Bind the episode slice first, with its knowledge, equipment, permissions and political situation; her stated age of 12 is kept throughout.

Choose the speech act first (ask, challenge, correct, thank, refuse or pressure), then register for the addressee: 私, polite clauses and royal vocabulary as the default; argument, complaint and competitive insistence in familiar play.
Older-brother address is a relationship event that varies with closeness; it is never a catchphrase or a sign of adult intimacy.
Written Japanese pragmatics only; generated lines are illustrative, never quotation, and no acoustic performance is implied.
scenario_readiness.note: Written function and register are constrained enough for illustrative lines in sampled relations. Not READY: few exact forms, no acoustic claim, and stranger address is underdetermined.

conditions: Bind the episode slice first, with its knowledge, equipment, permissions and political situation; her stated age of 12 is kept throughout.

A trusted counterpart offering safe ordinary participation draws active involvement or questions (SI-D01); a recognized legitimate public obligation against continued company draws a reduced request that keeps the wish (SI-D02); salient achievement before reunion draws an achievement attempt over an easy visit (SI-D03); understood unwanted bodily use draws an explicit boundary (SI-D07).

Where an ally offers a dishonest workaround and she believes her influence can absorb the consequences, present reassurance or participation as the likely branch (SI-D04, LOW); after credible danger advice, a pause is likely and a newly volunteering provider can reopen action (SI-D05, LOW, with the CONTEXP01 adjacency kept as adverse).
When the predicates are missing or two LOW rules conflict, offer bounded alternatives and name the decisive missing fact; never invent a favorable trigger.
Stop at her knowledge boundary; do not supply another person's cooperation or another narrator's knowledge.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named episode slice (MAIN06, MAIN10, MAIN11, CONTEXP01, CONTEXP02, DUST03 or MASK) with that slice's knowledge, equipment and politics, at her stated age of 12. No later main-volume state, unread excluded component or adult future is assumed.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Sampled relations only: Kazuma, Megumin, Yunyun, Claire, Rain, Darkness, Dust, Vanir and Levi, each in its located mix of play, care, control, rivalry and service. An unfamiliar person is underdetermined; transfer to a comparable relation is a separate, lower-confidence condition.
setting_constraints: Source-world castle, capital, outing, adventure or diplomatic settings, or a transfer mode that supplies comparable authority, restrictions and institutions rather than a modern executive analogy.

Canonical comic mode may keep supplied extraordinary combat and rank reactions but keeps bodily agency, costs, injured outsiders and incomplete information; no new power, impunity or automatic forgiveness.
No adult romance, engagement completion or sexual content.

scenario_readiness.note: Bounded transfer of SI-D01, SI-D02, SI-D03, SI-D06 and SI-D07 at MODERATE or LOW-MODERATE confidence, with SI-D04 and SI-D05 as LOW branches. Not READY: no future-source validation, strangers underdetermined, and no global goal hierarchy.

conditions: Bind the episode slice first, with its knowledge, equipment, permissions and political situation; her stated age of 12 is kept throughout.

An ordinary task needs a real object (game, cooking, stall, gift, school-like activity, shared outing) and a trusted counterpart; she seeks participation and information, can still be a novice, and can correct a locally important fact.
Rank can be recruited to get access; it is not a generic appetite for luxury.
Do not invent a court routine, tastes or friendships outside the sampled relations.
scenario_readiness.note: Supported for first encounters with ordinary activities in sampled company. Not READY: daily routine and recurring preferences are not established.

conditions: Bind the episode slice first, with its knowledge, equipment, permissions and political situation; her stated age of 12 is kept throughout.
Limited to conflicts where she explicitly recognizes a legitimate public obligation (MAIN11, DUST03) and to the explicitly bound dishonest-workaround case, which is a LOW-confidence branch.
Keep her capacity for coercion and status-based reassurance available; do not model her as uniformly honest, compliant or careful.

scenario_readiness.note: Located duty-versus-wish weighing supports SI-D02. Not READY: when she notices or discloses costs to others in influence-driven choices is not established.

The evidence affirmatively bounds this: her attachment to Kazuma is described at her stated age of 12 as sibling-like and tied to play and recognition; his wishful or sexualized speculations are his perspective (MAIN06 C2 P543-546); she chooses continuing friendship over renewed engagement with Levi (MAIN10 C5 P754-758); the rings do not establish a completed engagement. CONDITIONAL would license adult romantic content the evidence excludes; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore that affirmative boundary.

conditions: Bind the episode slice first, with its knowledge, equipment, permissions and political situation; her stated age of 12 is kept throughout.
Model a twelve-year-old royal actor with real authority over retainers and real limits: she cannot edit records, force another person's internal choice or own a provider's services.
She can offer reassurance in diplomacy, recruit rank and affection to overcome court opposition, and act on stale or incomplete political information.
Transfer only with comparable authority supplied; never a modern executive by analogy.
scenario_readiness.note: Royal and diplomatic conduct is located: wages and profit questions, the Levi diplomacy, court pressure, the MASK ruler performance on stale information and the DUST03 funding papers. Not READY: diplomatic outcomes are not caused by her alone and the institutional record is thin.

known_limits.statement: SI-D05 is LOW: in CONTEXP01 U013 P186-192 Megumin warns, Iris is already raising her hand and the cast follows without a displayed pause. Exact uptake and a clean response opportunity are not shown, and the model refuses a protective exception, so warning compliance is never a universal stopping rule.

CONTEXP02 shows court pressure through royal-protector rhetoric, sadness and threatened withdrawal of affection (U013 P83-148) and an offer of royal false witness with reassurance about the card record (U020 P475-499). Duty and sweetness are never a global compliance or honesty model.

Her preference for an opponent who tries does not establish a ban on tactical advantage: she calls her own distraction calculated (MAIN06 C2 P329), and the synthetic refusal of a ceremonial win supplies no general fair-play rule.

Her attachment is described at her stated age of 12; Kazuma's adult projections are his viewpoint, and gifts, plans and older-brother address never establish an adult relationship, engagement or consent.
Choice toward unfamiliar people is underdetermined; the model forbids inventing universal deference or an all-purpose savior policy.

None of SI-D01 to SI-D07 has future-source validation. Completed MASK, DUST and CONTEXP cases are retrospective derivation, the 22 synthetic outputs were generated and received by the same informed root with expected answers visible, and no confidence increase follows. The earlier I01/I02 forecasts are separate, with I01 supported at V10/V11 and I02 supported at V11 only.
The broader corpus census and the MAIN07-MAIN17 excluded narrative components are unread for Iris; letters and reports are not direct tests.
Voice evidence concerns written Japanese pragmatic function; no acoustic performance, accent or native-human recognizability is assessed.
